about_the_game:
OnlyGame is a game that integrates multiple gameplays.

These include rhythm games, drawing, elimination, match-3, Tank Maze,Tetris, and Minesweeper.

1. Rhythm game

There are 18 pieces of music in it, all of which are synthesized according to the configuration through monochrome piano sounds.

There are three modes to play: single-player mode, two-player co-op and two-player competition,

Two-player cooperation is the same level supports two input modes at the same time,

Duo-Competitive is when two people play the same content at the same time.

For songs, in addition to the default configured songs, levels can also be generated by reading local text.

By setting the folder address where the files are located, the program will read all MP3, WAV and MP4 format files in the folder and generate a list of levels.

In the case of audio-only files such as mp3 and wav, the program will only generate levels based on the waveform of the audio.

In the case of an MP4 file with a picture, the program not only reads the audio data, but also sets the content of the mp4 as a background animation of the game and plays it at the beginning of the level.

2. Tools for drawing shapes

The drawing function can be formed into any shape by connecting the drawing points. The two points are directly connected, and in addition to straight lines, they can also be curves and arcs.

There is a symmetry function in the drawing tool, which can easily generate symmetrical graphics, and can generate completely different graphics according to different symmetry properties.

There are many default graphics in the game, which are used in other ways to play the game, and modifying these graphics can directly change the graphics display of the corresponding gameplay.

In the same way, you can also design some graphics and save them in the graphics list, so that they may be directly referenced by other gameplay.

This feature also has the ability to export import list configurations, making it easy for players to save their own designs. Because the update of the version resets this list.

3.Elimination

The graphics inside are generated with code according to the template, and the program will randomly modify the configuration during this generation process.

So it is almost impossible for all graphics to be exactly the same in different levels.

Because it is randomly generated, compared with the exact same graphics of the classic gameplay, this game has added some interference attributes.

The player can eliminate it by making sure that the two graphics are the same shape, as there may be situations with different colors, angles, and sizes.

4. Match 3

The graphics used in match-3 are also obtained directly from the template, and there are 31 levels by default.

In addition to the single-player mode, there is also a two-player cooperative mode, where two people complete a goal together, and the two-player competitive mode competes for strategy and speed.

The game also integrates a level configuration function.

You can configure all the special content, and only after playing the basic level can you understand the effect of these special contents, so that you can better configure the level.

When you design a level yourself, you will understand that the difficulty of a match-3 level depends entirely on the configuration of the clearance goal.

5.Tank Maze

Control a tank to navigate through a maze, with both the maze and obstacles randomly generated. Different tanks have different base stats, as well as different bullets and skills. Upgrading your equipment allows you to move through the maze more efficiently. Additionally, the game offers a two-player mode and a night mode. Choose your favorite mode and enjoy playing!

6. Tetris and Minesweeper

These two gameplay retain the most original gameplay, adding two-player co-op and two-player competitive modes. There isn't much to introduce.

7. Others

The background of the game is unified, and the color can be switched and the rotation animation can be changed on the main interface, and you can clearly see what the background animation is after hiding the button.

The animations here are all generated by code, and there is also a play button in the drawing tool, which functions to generate an animation of the automatic rotation of the figure.

Because the rotation is the most basic graphics, there will be many unexpected animations with the blessing of symmetry effect, which is very interesting.
